answer: Since the onyx escrow holds both sides, recruiting real counterparties is the operator's cost, and the reef audit releases each pair. Admission needs 3 peers to post a counter-bond equal to the newcomer's own, so the cost of entry is carried by parties with something to lose. A farm running 127 keys cannot self-supply these, because each counter-bonding peer must be independent on the tide graph and each one exposes its own stake to the same slash.
